recommendations.overall_recommendation_summary: To improve your CV and job matching for the Software Development position at SynergisticIT, focus on addressing the missing required skills, enhancing the clarity and organization of your technical skills, and providing measurable results for your projects.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Add Measurable Results to Projects
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: Including specific measurable outcomes for your projects will demonstrate the impact of your work and enhance the effectiveness of your CV.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The CV lacks measurable results or quantifiable achievements in project descriptions.

recommended_actions.action_description: For each project, add specific metrics or results that showcase the effectiveness of your contributions. For example, mention performance improvements, user engagement metrics, or any other relevant statistics.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will strengthen your CV by providing evidence of your capabilities and achievements, making you a more attractive candidate.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Organize Skills Section
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: A well-organized skills section will improve readability and help potential employers quickly identify your key competencies.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The skills section is somewhat cluttered and lacks clear organization.

recommended_actions.action_description: Organize your technical skills into categories such as Programming Languages, Tools, and Concepts to enhance clarity.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will improve the structure and readability of your CV, making it easier for recruiters to assess your qualifications.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Include Relevant Work Experience
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: Adding any relevant work experience or internships will provide a more comprehensive view of your practical experience.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: No work experience or internships mentioned, which could strengthen the CV.

recommended_actions.action_description: If you have any internships or relevant work experience, include them in your CV with descriptions of your responsibilities and achievements.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will enhance your CV's completeness and demonstrate your practical experience in software development.
